class.name: WebSVGPath
class.description: An arbitrary path in the scriptable SVG DOM, defined by an SVG path-data string. See [WebSVGElement] for the shared fill, stroke and transform properties.

members.member: The SVG path data, for example [code]M10 10 H 90 V 90 H 10 Z[/code]. SVG [code]d[/code].
